exposure: women with one previous caesarean section scar
outcome: duration of the active phase of labour
cohort: The study included 390 women, comprising primiparous women and women with one previous caesarean section scar, who were booked for antenatal checkups and labour at the Gynaecology and Obstetrics Department of Pak Emirates Military Hospital.
finding: The main parameters of the partogram, specifically the duration of the active phase of labour, time to progress by 1 cm, and time after the alert line, differed significantly between primiparous women and women with one previous caesarean section scar.
